constructedRequest.name: Channel + higher high
constructedRequest.note: Built for WEEK (on DAY it runs too, but it is a different strategy). Buy a higher high while the close sits low in the current channel (POSITION in [BuyLow, BuyHigh]); short / exit on a lower low high in the channel (POSITION >= SellLow); exit below the channel (POSITION <= StopPos) and when the channel disappears (no current channel). Channels: semantics B, the tree after t-1, detector 0.95 / 5 / 0.05, current channel (minAgeBars 0).

Lower low in the sell zone of the current channel
Close below the channel: protective exit
No current channel: exit (owner 2026-11-12)
